Ivy (Docs): working on a tiny PR to clarify tiered usage behavior + SDK snippets for headers and a grafana promql. plan: concise FAQ, 3 mini-snippets, an express middleware example, and a short reconciliation note. opening later today.

Sam (DevEx): good. keep snippets copy-paste ready for quickstart. show both new and legacy header names.

Diego (Eng): prod headers are X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota-Window; X-Quota-* kept for older clients. paste a tiny middleware you can use.

Diego (Eng): ```js
// attach quota info from response headers
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  const r = res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');
  const w = res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Window')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Window');
  req.quota = { remaining: Number(r||0), windowSec: Number(w||0) }; next();
});
```

Rhea (PM): add an FAQ bullet about downgrades mid-cycle: credits are prorated and there is typically a short grace period; link billing playbook for enterprise terms.

Liam (Billing): yes — avoid exact promises. phrase as: "typically a short (~7 day) grace period; enterprise agreements may differ." also add a one-line reconciliation tip: use billing exports + redwood_tokens_consumed_total for spot checks.

Ivy (Docs): drafting node snippet: ```js
// node fetch quota check
const r = await fetch(url,{headers});
console.log('rem', r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') || r.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining'))
```

Ivy (Docs): python snippet: ```py
# python requests quick check
r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(int(r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') or 0))
```

Ivy (Docs): curl one-liner: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $URL | grep -i X-Redwood-Quota
```

Sam (DevEx): nice. add a line: Console -> Usage analytics -> Per-route shows cumulative consumed vs remaining; headers are per-request snapshot. include console link in PR.

Diego (Eng): grafana promql to show 7d consumption by customer tier (exclude internal/test): ```promql
sum by(customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env="prod", customer_type!~"internal|test"}[7d]))
```
Legend: {{customer_tier}}

Liam (Billing): include the reconciliation hint and link to the billing export guide (one-line).

DocsBot: PR template reminder: add changelog entry + migration note + billing crosslink when pricing/credits affected.

Ivy (Docs): will add changelog and migration section mentioning header rename and impact on SDKs. opening PR at 1758402000 and tagging @Sam, @Diego, @Liam for quick review. QA smoke-check request: please run snippets in staging.

Sam (DevEx): i'll drop into quickstart and smoke test.

Diego (Eng): i'll validate promql on staging metrics and confirm header behavior.

Ivy (Docs): thanks all — aiming to merge today if QA passes. small docs fixes like this save support time. :clap:
